title: Presales Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONPRE-SALES MANAGER

**Company:** SiyaOne Property Solutions Pvt. Ltd.  
**Brand:** SiyaOne – Where Homes Begin  
**Location:** Hyderabad  
**Department:** Sales & Pre-Sales  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years in Real Estate Pre-Sales / Inside Sales  
**Salary:** ₹25,000 – ₹35,000 per month + Performance Incentives

About SiyaOne

SiyaOne Property Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a growing real estate and property solutions company focused on creating a complete property ecosystem across Real Estate Sales, Home Loans, Interiors, Insurance, Digital Marketing, Property Management, and related property services.

We are looking for a **Pre-Sales Manager** who will take complete ownership of the pre-sales process, from the **first call to the customer through qualification, follow-up, site visit scheduling, and handover to the sales team**.

This is an **individual-contributor and target-driven role**. The Pre-Sales Manager will personally handle all assigned leads and customer communication.

Key Responsibilities1. Lead Calling & Qualification

* Personally call **100% of assigned leads** generated through Meta Ads, Google Ads, property portals, referrals, campaigns, and other sources.
* Make the first contact with leads within the defined response time.
* Understand the customer's:
* Budget
* Preferred location
* Property type
* Configuration
* Investment/personal-use requirement
* Purchase timeline
* Financing requirements
* Identify genuine and high-potential prospects.
* Explain relevant SiyaOne projects and property offerings accurately.
* Build strong relationships with prospects through professional communication.

2. Follow-Up Management

* Personally handle **all follow-ups** for assigned leads.
* Maintain consistent follow-up until the customer:
* Schedules a site visit
* Visits the project
* Converts into a booking
* Or is officially marked as lost/not interested
* Maintain a structured follow-up schedule through calls and WhatsApp.
* Ensure no qualified lead becomes inactive due to lack of follow-up.
* Reconnect with older and dormant leads wherever there is conversion potential.

3. Site Visit Generation

* Convert qualified leads into confirmed site visits.
* Explain project USPs, pricing, location, amenities, payment plans, and other relevant details.
* Coordinate with the Sales Team for scheduled site visits.
* Ensure the sales team receives complete customer information before the visit.
* Track whether scheduled site visits actually happen.
* Follow up with customers after the site visit and update the sales team/management.

4. CRM & Lead Management

* Update every lead accurately in the CRM/lead tracker.
* Maintain complete records of:
* Calls
* Follow-ups
* Customer requirements
* Lead status
* Site visit dates
* Customer feedback
* Next follow-up date
* Conversion status
* Ensure **zero unworked or unattended leads**.
* Maintain accurate daily lead reports.

5. Sales Coordination

* Work closely with Sales Managers and Sales Executives.
* Handover qualified prospects to the sales team with complete customer information.
* Coordinate with the sales team regarding site visits and customer requirements.
* Follow up with the sales team regarding the status of each customer.
* Support the sales team in re-engaging customers who have not yet converted.

6. Reporting & Performance

Submit daily and weekly reports covering:

* Total leads received
* Leads called
* Connected leads
* Qualified leads
* Follow-ups completed
* Site visits scheduled
* Site visits completed
* Hot/Warm/Cold leads
* Pending follow-ups
* Lost leads
* Sales opportunities generated
* Bookings/conversions
* Lead source performance

Key KPIs

The Pre-Sales Manager will be evaluated primarily on **conversion and revenue contribution**, not simply the number of calls made.

**Primary KPIs:**

* 100% lead calling coverage
* Lead response time
* Lead qualification rate
* Follow-up completion rate
* Qualified leads generated
* Site visits scheduled
* Site visits completed
* Site visit conversion rate
* Booking conversion
* Revenue/pipeline generated
* CRM accuracy
* Customer follow-up quality

Candidate Profile

* 2–5 years of experience in **Real Estate Pre-Sales / Inside Sales / Tele-Sales**.
* Strong experience in personally handling real estate leads.
* Excellent communication and convincing skills.
* Strong follow-up and relationship-management ability.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and recommend suitable properties.
* Strong objection-handling and negotiation skills.
* Target-oriented and highly disciplined.
* Good knowledge of Hyderabad real estate will be preferred.
* Proficiency in English, Telugu, and Hindi is preferred.
* Comfortable working with CRM, Excel, Google Sheets, WhatsApp Business, and calling systems.

Important Requirement

**This is NOT a purely managerial or supervisory position.**

The Pre-Sales Manager is expected to **personally handle calling and follow-ups for all assigned leads** and take complete ownership of converting leads into qualified opportunities and site visits.

The candidate must be comfortable with **high-volume calling, continuous follow-ups, customer interaction, and monthly sales targets**.

Compensation

**₹25,000 – ₹35,000 per month + Performance Incentives**

Incentives can be linked to:

**Qualified Lead → Site Visit → Completed Site Visit → Booking**

High performers will have opportunities for additional incentives and career growth within SiyaOne.

Reporting To

**Sales Director / Managing Director**

Application Requirements

Candidates should submit:

* Updated Resume
* Current Salary
* Expected Salary
* Notice Period
* Total Real Estate Experience
* Pre-Sales/Inside Sales Experience
* Team-handling experience, if any
* Current Location

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹420,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid time off

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Hyderabad, Telangana 500091: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Experience:

* Real estate sales: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Founding AI FDE Lead / Architect – Enterprise AI Solutions
description:
**The Opportunity – Build, Lead & Architect the Future of Enterprise AI**

We are looking for a **Founding AI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) Lead / Architect** to take ownership of Anthrobyte's end-to-end AI technology function.

This is not a conventional AI leadership position focused solely on strategy, team management, or architecture reviews. It is a high-impact, hands-on leadership opportunity for someone who can move seamlessly between enterprise client conversations, AI solution architecture, hands-on engineering, production deployment, and technology leadership.

You will work directly with the CEO and enterprise stakeholders, translating complex business challenges into scalable, production-ready AI solutions.

From identifying high-value AI opportunities and architecting intelligent systems to building engineering teams, establishing project pods, and driving successful enterprise deployments, you will own the complete AI solution lifecycle.

**Your mandate will be to build the technology function, establish architectural excellence, lead client-facing AI engagements, and evolve Anthrobyte's engineering capabilities as the company scales.**

Key Responsibilities1. Enterprise AI Consulting & Strategic Client Engagement

* Lead enterprise and mid-market client engagements across global markets, driving technical discovery and AI transformation conversations.
* Engage directly with CXOs, CTOs, CIOs, VPs of Operations, and technology decision-makers to understand business challenges, operational bottlenecks, and AI opportunities.
* Conduct AI readiness assessments, technical workshops, stakeholder interviews, and value-stream mapping exercises.
* Translate ambiguous business requirements into clearly defined AI use cases, technical roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes.
* Establish yourself as a trusted AI advisor, building strategic client relationships that drive long-term partnerships and business expansion.

2. Pre-Sales, Solution Consulting & Business Enablement

* Own technical pre-sales engagements, solution discovery, opportunity qualification, and AI solution positioning.
* Develop compelling Proof of Concepts (PoCs), technical demonstrations, architecture blueprints, and enterprise solution proposals.
* Lead technical responses to RFPs, RFIs, and complex enterprise solution requirements.
* Define solution scope, implementation feasibility, data requirements, resource estimates, delivery timelines, and expected ROI.
* Partner with the commercial and leadership teams to convert enterprise opportunities into successful AI engagements.

3. AI Architecture & Hands-on Engineering Leadership

* Design and architect scalable, secure, production-grade AI/ML systems for complex enterprise environments.
* Lead the development of advanced AI capabilities, including:
* Large Language Models (LLMs) and Small Language Models (SLMs).
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
* Agentic AI systems and multi-agent orchestration.
* Multimodal AI solutions.
* NLP and Computer Vision applications.
* LLM orchestration, intelligent automation, and workflow agents.
* Enterprise AI integrations and advanced analytics.
* Build and optimize AI pipelines using Python and frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, and other emerging technologies.
* Drive cloud-native AI architecture and deployment across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Establish best practices for model evaluation, prompt engineering, observability, MLOps, model monitoring, security, and governance.
* Optimize inference costs, token consumption, cloud credits, model performance, latency, and infrastructure utilization.
* Remain technically hands-on and capable of debugging, prototyping, and solving complex engineering challenges.

4. End-to-End Delivery & Production Ownership

* Own the complete AI solution lifecycle, from initial discovery and architecture through development, deployment, and continuous optimization.
* Ensure seamless integration with enterprise systems, databases, APIs, and existing business workflows.
* Drive production readiness, deployment planning, scalability, reliability, and performance optimization.
* Oversee go-live milestones, client acceptance, and post-deployment performance.
* Establish measurable success metrics and ensure solutions deliver tangible business value.
* Take complete accountability for production issues, technical challenges, and solution improvements.

5. Technology Function & Engineering Team Leadership

* Build and develop Anthrobyte's AI engineering and technology function from the ground up.
* Establish a scalable engineering organization with clearly defined ownership, responsibilities, and delivery standards.
* Create dedicated project-based engineering pods, aligning AI engineers, data scientists, backend engineers, and consultants with individual client engagements.
* Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams.
* Establish engineering standards, architectural governance, technical documentation, and development methodologies.
* Build reusable frameworks, accelerators, and solution components to improve delivery efficiency.
* Develop a culture of technical ownership, experimentation, collaboration, and execution excellence.

6. Technology Innovation & Product Evolution

* Define and continuously evolve Anthrobyte's enterprise AI architecture strategy.
* Identify emerging AI technologies, frameworks, research, and industry developments that can create a competitive advantage.
* Translate relevant innovations into practical enterprise solutions and reusable product capabilities.
* Work closely with the leadership team to evolve the company's services-plus-product business model.
* Contribute to the product roadmap, technology vision, and long-term engineering strategy.
* Develop technical case studies, internal playbooks, solution accelerators, and architecture standards.

**Ideal Candidate Profile:-**

We are looking for a technology leader who combines deep AI engineering expertise, enterprise consulting capabilities, commercial awareness, and the entrepreneurial mindset required to build a technology organization from zero to one.

Mandatory Experience & Leadership Requirements

**1. AI/ML Engineering Experience**

* 7+ years of overall professional experience, with substantial hands-on experience delivering production-grade AI/ML solutions.
* Strong expertise in LLMs, NLP, Computer Vision, advanced analytics, or enterprise AI applications.
* Proven experience building and deploying sophisticated AI systems rather than working exclusively on research or theoretical implementations.

**2. Advanced AI Architecture & Engineering**

* Demonstrated expertise in designing and implementing RAG pipelines, SLMs, agentic AI systems, multi-agent workflows, LLM orchestration, and multimodal architectures.
* Ability to make hands-on technical decisions involving model selection, fine-tuning, evaluation, inference optimization, and deployment.
* Strong understanding of AI infrastructure, scalability, performance, cost optimization, and production constraints.

**3. Enterprise Client-Facing & Consulting Experience**

* At least 4 years of experience in client-facing technical consulting, enterprise solution architecture, pre-sales, or AI solution delivery.
* Proven experience engaging with CXOs, VPs, business leaders, and enterprise technology stakeholders.
* Strong track record in technical discovery, solution design, business case development, PoC demonstrations, and enterprise proposals.

**4. AI Solution Delivery & Implementation**

* Experience owning end-to-end enterprise AI implementations, including data ingestion, pipelines, model development, integration, deployment, monitoring, and optimization.
* Strong understanding of production environments, enterprise integrations, deployment challenges, and change management.
* Demonstrated accountability for successful go-live, client acceptance, and post-deployment outcomes.

**5. Team Building & Technology Leadership**

* Proven experience building, managing, and mentoring AI/ML engineering teams.
* Ability to establish project-based engineering pods and manage multiple client delivery engagements.
* Experience defining technical standards, architecture patterns, delivery processes, and engineering practices.
* Capable of balancing strategic leadership with hands-on technical execution.

**6. Technical Skills**

* **Programming:** Python.
* **AI/ML:** LLMs, SLMs, NLP, Computer Vision, Deep Learning.
* **Frameworks:** LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face.
* **AI Architecture:** RAG, Agentic AI, Multi-Agent Systems, Multimodal AI, LLM Orchestration.
* **Cloud Platforms:** AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform.
* **Engineering:** API Integrations, MLOps, Model Deployment, Monitoring, AI Optimization.

**7. Business & Communication Skills**

* Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to explain complex AI architectures and technical concepts to non-technical business stakeholders.
* Strong business acumen with an understanding of enterprise ROI, commercial feasibility, and solution scalability.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity and taking ownership in a fast-moving startup environment.

Preferred Industry & Background

* Experience working with AI/ML services companies, enterprise technology firms, data analytics organizations, or AI-focused product companies.
* Exposure to both services-led consulting and product development environments.
* Experience in early-stage startups or high-growth organizations, particularly in building AI solutions from the ground up.
* Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Logistics, B2B SaaS, Enterprise AI, or MLOps domain exposure will be a strong advantage.
* Experience serving international clients, particularly across the US, Europe, Middle East, or Southeast Asia.

**Educational Background:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related technical discipline.
* Graduates from IITs, BITS, NITs, IIITs, or other reputed institutions are preferred.
* Strong technical expertise and demonstrated delivery capabilities will also be considered.

Pay: ₹6,000,000.00 - ₹9,000,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* How many years of overall professional experience do you have, including at least 7 years in AI/ML, software engineering, or related technology domains?
* Do you have a minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience in enterprise client-facing roles, AI consulting, solution architecture, or technical pre-sales, including CXO-level stakeholder engagement?
* Have you independently architected and deployed production-grade AI solutions involving LLMs, RAG pipelines, SLMs, Agentic AI, or multi-agent workflows?
* Are you proficient in Python, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP), with practical implementation experience?
* Have you owned end-to-end enterprise AI engagements, including technical discovery, business use-case identification, solution architecture, PoC development, RFP/RFI responses, and production deployment?
* Have you independently managed production AI systems, including enterprise integrations, MLOps, monitoring, model optimization, inference cost reduction, and troubleshooting?
* Have you built and led AI/ML engineering teams, established project-based delivery pods, and mentored engineers while remaining technically hands-on?
* Do you have professional experience across both AI/ML services or consulting and AI product development environments, preferably in an early-stage or high-growth organization?
* Are you willing to work from the office five days a week at Kokapet, Hyderabad, and initially join on a consultant basis with the possibility of transitioning to full-time employment?
* What are your current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, and earliest possible joining date?

title: Executive Assistant to CEO and Executive Operations Coordinator
description:
Executive Assistant to CEO and Executive Operations Coordinator

**Job Type:** Full-time, Permanent  
**Location:** India, Remote Initially  
**Work Arrangement:** Remote initially, with potential hybrid or in-office work in Hyderabad in 2027-2028  
**Business Hours:** U.S. Eastern Time business hours. Approximately 7:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST during U.S. standard time, and 6:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST during U.S. daylight saving time.  
**Reports To:** Chief Executive Officer

About the Role

We are a growing U.S.-based IT services and technology reseller with back-office operations and support teams in India and Latin America.

We are hiring a highly organized, mature, and confidential Executive Assistant to support the CEO directly. This role combines executive support, meeting management, project coordination, leadership follow-up, and CEO office operations.

The successful candidate will help the CEO stay focused on high-value priorities by managing schedules, preparing meetings, tracking decisions, following up on commitments, organizing documents, and coordinating key company projects.

This is a high-trust role. You will have access to confidential business, financial, personnel, client, leadership, and limited personal information. Discretion, good judgment, strong English, and reliability are essential.

Key ResponsibilitiesCEO Support

* Manage the CEO’s calendar, meeting schedule, reminders, and priorities
* Coordinate internal and external meetings across U.S., India, Peru, and other time zones
* Prepare meeting agendas, pre-reads, background information, and follow-up materials
* Review and organize incoming requests, emails, documents, and meeting invitations
* Flag urgent items, decisions, risks, and deadlines requiring CEO attention
* Draft professional emails, messages, summaries, and follow-up communication for CEO review
* Coordinate travel, appointments, and limited personal logistics when assigned

Leadership Meeting Management

* Support weekly leadership meetings, revenue meetings, strategy meetings, and one-on-one meetings
* Record decisions, action items, owners, deadlines, and blockers
* Maintain a leadership action tracker
* Follow up with department heads before deadlines
* Escalate overdue, blocked, or high-risk items to the CEO
* Create concise meeting summaries and send them to appropriate attendees

Executive Operations and Project Coordination

* Maintain the CEO’s master priority list and company transformation tracker
* Track major projects across Finance, Operations, HR, Sales, Service Delivery, compliance, systems, hiring, and consultants
* Maintain project status, owners, deadlines, deliverables, risks, and next steps
* Coordinate meetings, documents, and deliverables with consultants, vendors, contractors, and internal leaders
* Ensure action items from consultants and leadership are tracked through completion
* Prepare simple decision briefs for the CEO that summarize the issue, recommendation, cost, risk, owner, and deadline

Document and Information Management

* Organize confidential CEO, leadership, consultant, finance, HR, legal, and project documents
* Maintain secure folders, meeting notes, decision logs, action trackers, and executive dashboards
* Ensure documents are stored in approved company systems
* Maintain version control and easy access to current documents
* Protect all confidential information and follow company security requirements

Hiring and Administrative Coordination

* Coordinate candidate interviews, leadership interviews, consultant calls, and follow-up communication
* Track candidate status, interview feedback, screening information, and next steps
* Support contract, NDA, invoice, and approval routing
* Assist with creating presentations, meeting notes, reports, and executive documents
* Coordinate with Operations, HR, Finance, Sales, and Service Delivery as needed

Required Skills and Experience

* 4 or more years of experience supporting a CEO, founder, executive, senior leader, or business owner
* Experience working in an Executive Assistant, Chief of Staff Assistant, Executive Operations, or Project Coordinator role
* Excellent spoken and written English
* Strong organization, follow-up, prioritization, and time-management skills
* Ability to work independently with limited direction
* Strong judgment and ability to handle confidential information
* Experience supporting meetings, calendars, executive communications, and action tracking
* Advanced Microsoft 365 skills, including Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint or OneDrive
* Experience using project-management, CRM, HR, or finance platforms such as Zoho, ClickUp, Asana, Monday.com, HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar systems
* Comfortable working U.S. Eastern Time business hours
* Stable internet connection and professional remote-work environment

Preferred Experience

* Experience supporting a CEO in an IT services, MSP, technology, SaaS, cybersecurity, consulting, or professional services company
* Experience coordinating teams across the United States, India, and Latin America
* Experience creating executive dashboards, reports, and PowerPoint presentations
* Experience working with Finance, HR, Sales, Operations, and Service Delivery leaders
* Experience supporting a founder-led or rapidly growing company

Success Measures

Success in this role means:

* The CEO enters meetings prepared with the right information
* Every meeting has documented decisions, owners, and deadlines
* Leadership action items are tracked and followed up consistently
* The CEO has a clear daily and weekly view of priorities, risks, decisions, and overdue items
* Consultants, department leaders, and project owners receive timely follow-up
* Important work does not get lost across emails, chats, meetings, and documents
* Confidential information remains secure and properly organized
* The CEO spends more time on strategy, growth, clients, partnerships, and major decisions

Application Instructions

Please include the following in your application:

* Your experience supporting a CEO, founder, or senior executive.
* Your experience working U.S. Eastern Time business hours from India.
* The tools you have used for calendar management, project tracking, meeting notes, and executive reporting.
* An example of how you tracked action items across multiple department heads.
* Your current salary, expected salary, and notice period.
* Your English proficiency rating from 1 to 10.
* A short written example of a professional follow-up email you would send after a leadership meeting.

Pay: ₹28,000.00 - ₹37,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Work from home

description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**

**Position Title:** Senior Consultant, RTO

**Location:** Hyderabad, India

**Employment:** Full time, regular, hybrid work arrangement

**Main responsibilities**


RTO Candidate will be responsible for \-

* Managing day\-to\-day technical activities of the Real Time Optimisation (RTO) and Data Reconciliation \& Yield Accounting team for deliveries of projects to clients in domestic \& global locations in various Chemicals, Oil \& Gas (COG) viz. the Refinery \& Hydrocarbon industries and the Fossil fuel Power generation industries
* Working with its end clients and ensure quality \& timely deliveries to the assigned projects with full client satisfaction.
* Technical planning to deliver project demands based on local/regional forecasts
* Participating in pre\-sales activities (Validation of manhour estimates, proposals review etc.) as and when required.
* Meeting company defined KPI’s applicable to the team.

 **Essential skills and experience required**

* Candidates should have strong chemical Engineering fundamentals.
* Should have total of 8\+ years of experience out of which he/she should have hands on experience on Steady state \&/or dynamic simulations for at least 3\+ years.
* For remaining experience, Hydrocarbon plant operations experience will be considered relevant.
* Proficiency in implementation of simulations Models (using commercial RTO software i.e., ROMeo, etc.), Yield accounting, APC will be preferred,
* Good problem solving, communication, interpersonal and team playing skills

 **Qualification:**

* B Tech/M Tech Chemical Engineering as a minimum.

**Services at AVEVA**


Our dynamic global team of 700\+ engineers, developers, consultants, solution architects and project managers are at the forefront of delivering AVEVA cutting\-edge solutions to customers. The work is complex and technical, but immensely rewarding: we empower customers to harness the full transformative potential of AVEVA’s solutions. If you’re analytical, pragmatic, and driven to make a tangible impact on the sustainability of the industrial sector, our team is the perfect place for you.


You’ll also be joining an award\-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® Certified™ in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our awards and recognition.


Find out more: https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/

 **India Benefits include:**


Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well\-being support


It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.

  

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

 **Hybrid working**


We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on\-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office\-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.

 **Hiring process**


Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.

AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting\-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.

  

We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability\-report.aveva.com/
